description.description: A CCTV recording in a kitchen. The first frame shows a German Shepherd on its hind legs reaching for a pot on the stove while a woman attempts to pull it away. The second frame, timestamped earlier, shows a large grease fire on the stove spreading through the kitchen with smoke filling the top of the frame.
